scope: Dedicated SBS Radar writer principal identity only. Workspace assignment/run-as roles, data grants, OAuth secrets and compute activation are separate unexecuted phases.
reconciliation: One POST attempt only; always exact applicationId filtered GET after. If response ambiguous, preserve unknown creation attribution and stop; never retry POST or adopt by displayName. Existing applicationId stops create.
postconditions: record returned roles/groups/entitlements field presence; absence is not proof of no inherited permissions
authorization_basis: Approved E2E mission requires dedicated writer separate from app reader; identity metadata preparation within own project scope. No resource-billing authorization inferred.

sources.claim: Workspace admins can manage account principals via workspace-domain /api/2.0/account/scim/v2; workspace assignment is separate.
Service principal list supports exact applicationId filter; POST returns id and applicationId. PDF create example uses User schema inconsistently; use SDK ServicePrincipal enum, not that typo.
Optional application_id UUID serialized as applicationId, active, displayName and ServicePrincipal schema supported. Endpoint proxy mapping documented separately.
